text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I was adjusting
our schedule—
choice_data_list: (I'll be able to take some consecutive time off this month...)
(I might be able to take some consecutive time off this month...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, Tosen Jordan has won
various races and is currently
in her prime growth phase.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While it's fine for her to rest, as her Trainer, taking a break myself is—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No, get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You don't get much time off, right?
Then just take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, why even stress over it in the first place? Basically, if you and I take time off together, problem solved, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Here we are, the hot spring inn.
Well then, take it easy and relax.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No, but you won hot springs tickets, right?
Then we kinda have to go, don't we?
choice_data_list: Still, you and your friends were...
Still, you and your friends were...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like I said when I won the tickets,
it'd be awkward picking just one person to go with.
I love all of you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Still, it makes sense coming from you, right?
Like, 'Oh, did she go there to loosen up her muscles or something?'

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Look, I just wanna soak in the bath already.
Walk through the curtain already.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah... That bath felt so good~.
choice_data_list: Looks like you enjoyed the hot springs to the fullest too.
Looks like you enjoyed the hot springs too

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Duh, obviously. No way I'm coming all this way
and leaving without getting my money's worth.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, look, ping-pong.
Trainer, do you know how to play?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haha, then let's make it a contest.
Loser buys the juice, deal?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Tosen Jordan approached the ping-pong table...
and the battle officially commenced!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clang... clonk...!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh!? What kind of course is that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Opposite of where Tosen Jordan was on the left...
I aim for the very edge of the right side of the table and strike the ball!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
!? Dammit...!
Cover me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, as expected of an Umamusume.
Reacting instantly, Tosen Jordan reaches out
her right hand toward the ball..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Craaaash!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Aaaaagh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...and smashed it with a tremendous crash.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, geez~~~!
If only I'd nailed that just now, I would've won~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Man, it's hot...
Maybe I'll go take another bath.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Is it okay if I get your juice after this?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
By the way, no messing around on your phone
while you wait for me, got it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: 'Cause you look like you'd actually work.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Anything other than that is fine.
Just play video games or whatever."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...However, even after that,
Tosen Jordan didn't return to her room and continued lounging around in mine."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what's with this TV?
It's full of celebs I've never heard of.
Lol, so boring.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Who knows? Either's fine by me, right?
As long as there's something to watch.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, doesn't this place kinda feel like Grandma's house during summer vacation?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'll go for now, but there's nothing fun there.
Just, like, find your own way to enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "To be honest, it's so boring that when it's time to leave, I'm just happy thinking 'Finally, I get to go home~'."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Still, that was way later.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It reminds me of the breeze that suddenly rushed in
when I opened the screen door at Grandma's house.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"And so... ahh, it makes me think back to,
like, way back when I went to my grandma's place."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I dunno why, but that day's just...
still alive inside of me, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I think the day will probably come
when I look back on today just like that.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...That's why I'm saying.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan opens the window.
A breeze, warmer than her skin, caresses her cheek.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...I hope you end up like that too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
with Tosen Jordan...
